notablePrerequisites: There are at least five creature cards in all graveyards.
description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Drakestown Forgotten. Drakestown Forgotten enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Drakestown Forgotten using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
